niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel light, airy, and polished, with clear hierarchy, concise copy, and enough content to feel complete. They like screens that are easy to scan, use coherent section grouping, and show obvious primary actions and controls. They generally favor brighter or softer visual treatments over dark/heavy ones, but they also want the layout to feel populated and functional rather than sparse or empty.

criteria.description: Prefers light, bright, airy interfaces with soft backgrounds and low visual heaviness rather than dark, heavy surfaces.
Prefers strong hierarchy with a prominent title, clear section separation, and obvious primary actions.
Prefers screens that look fully populated and finished, with visible rows, labels, and controls rather than empty or placeholder-like areas.
Prefers layouts that feel informative and functional, with enough content to avoid wasted space, but not so much that the screen becomes cluttered.
Prefers short, direct, benefit-led, or action-oriented copy over verbose explanatory text.
Prefers content organized into clearly separated, logically grouped sections or cards that are easy to understand at a glance.
Prefers screens that are easy to scan because they use fewer competing blocks, clear grouping, and consistent row structure.
Prefers a clearly emphasized main action button or next step that stands out from secondary controls.
Prefers a warm, welcoming, modern, and coherent presentation that feels finished and intentional.
Prefers straightforward navigation with minimal chrome, fewer visible destinations, and clear back/next progression.
Prefers controls that are visually obvious and easy to interpret, such as distinct toggles, segmented choices, or clearly labeled actions.
Prefers some whitespace and spacing between elements so the interface feels breathable rather than tightly packed.
Prefers interfaces with fewer decorative distractions, fewer competing accents, and less clutter in headers, footers, and content areas.
Prefers explicit labels, counts, names, and status details that make the screen feel informative and trustworthy.
Prefers card-based or modular layouts when they help structure content cleanly and make the screen feel contemporary.
Prefers icons and accent colors that support the layout without becoming overly decorative or dominant.
Prefers seeing surrounding app context rather than isolated, floating modal-only presentations.
Prefers titles and messages that are specific about the situation and next step, rather than generic alerts.
